name: Verify Feature Flags
description: Verify that requested features were correctly applied to the provisioned ROSA HCP cluster by checking CRDs, OCM API, and AWS resources

playbooks.name: Verify Feature Flags
playbooks.description: Checks each requested feature against the cluster CRDs, OCM API, and AWS CLI to verify it was applied correctly

documentation.overview: This test suite verifies that features requested during provisioning (via --feature or --feature-group) were correctly applied. It checks CRDs, queries the OCM API, and validates AWS resources. Features not requested are SKIPped, not FAILed.
prerequisites: A provisioned ROSA HCP cluster (suite 20 must have passed)
CLUSTER_FEATURES or FEATURE_GROUP must be set
AWS credentials for AWS CLI checks

quick_start.description: Verifies that the specified features were applied to the named cluster
